description: This file contains a generic class 'CustomStorageAdaptor' implementing log view adaptation for Orleans grains using custom storage interfaces. It handles reading and writing log states, notification processing, and error handling for storage operations, tailored to a specific storage interface 'ICustomStorageInterface'.

classes.name: CustomStorageAdaptor
classes.description: A log consistency adaptor that interacts with a user-provided custom storage interface to manage log views within Orleans. Implements reading, writing, notification handling, and error recovery for log view states.

classes.name: ReadRequest
classes.description: Message used to request the current log state, includes the known version for optimization.

classes.name: ReadResponse
classes.description: Response message containing the current version and value of the log view, generic over the view type.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationMessage
classes.description: Notification sent to remote instances indicating a new log version, containing the applied updates.

classes.name: UpdatePrimaryFailed
classes.description: Exception data class indicating failure when updating the primary storage.

classes.name: ReadFromPrimaryFailed
classes.description: Exception data class indicating failure when reading from primary storage.

methods.name: LastConfirmedView
methods.description: Returns the cached confirmed log view.

methods.name: InitializeConfirmedView
methods.description: Initializes the cached view and version.

methods.name: MakeSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Creates a submission entry for a log entry.

methods.name: OnMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages, providing appropriate responses.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous reading of log state from storage with retries.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous writing of log updates to storage with error handling and retries.

methods.name: OnNotificationReceived
methods.description: Receives and queues notification messages for processing.

methods.name: ProcessNotifications
methods.description: Processes queued notifications to update local view state.
